document.title: Dilmurod Muhsinjonov — Personal Brand Website Design Specification
document.status: design direction locked; content placeholders remain

brand_direction.primary_goal: Shaxsiy brendni premium, esda qoladigan va hamkorlikka undaydigan tarzda ko‘rsatish.
brand_direction.visual_formula: Dark Luxury × Cinematic Storytelling × Editorial Typography × Swiss Precision × Controlled WebGL Motion

colors.gold_usage_rule: 5–8% of the total visual field; only for emphasis, active states, highlights, and rewards

typography.display_role: Hero name, section titles, project titles, statements, large stats
typography.body_role: Navigation, metadata, labels, body copy, UI controls

spacing.corner_radius: 0–6px for UI; circles reserved for orb and CTA

layout.scroll_model: continuous smooth scroll with sticky cinematic scenes

composition.right: liquid metallic orb with orbital rings
composition.background: near-black with subtle radial glow and hairline geometry

content.name: DILMUROD MUHSINJONOV
content.tagline_placeholder: [Your professional identity]. Turning ideas into deliberate, memorable digital experiences.

orb.look: liquid chrome / black mirror / silver with champagne-gold reflection
orb.mouse_response: very subtle; the orb follows the pointer without becoming playful

preloader.rule: Keep duration short enough to feel intentional, not decorative.

cursor.hover_state: ring expands to 50px and turns gold

intro_statement.purpose: Brendning dunyoqarashini bir katta fikr orqali yetkazish.
intro_statement.layout: large editorial statement centered in wide column
intro_statement.copy: I believe meaningful work begins where clarity, ambition and craftsmanship meet. I don't want to simply follow what comes next. I want to help shape it.

about.purpose: CV faktlaridan ko‘ra kuchliroq shaxsiy pozitsiya va ish uslubini ko‘rsatish.
about.layout: sticky visual left / scrolling content right
about.image_style: abstract editorial placeholder, film-grain atmosphere; replace later with real cropped editorial portrait if desired

journey.purpose: Muhim professional bosqichlarni storytelling shaklida berish.
journey.layout: sticky large milestone number + scrolling description
journey.active_state: year turns champagne gold and shifts 6px

selected_work.purpose: 3–5 ta eng kuchli loyihani fullscreen cinematic case-study preview sifatida ko‘rsatish.
selected_work.copy_rule: Short, outcome-oriented, no long paragraphs on the fullscreen slide.

stats.purpose: Qiymatni raqamlar orqali tez va ishonchli ko‘rsatish.
stats.layout: 2×2 editorial grid on desktop; stacked on mobile
stats.animation: count-up with gold flash at completion
stats.style: very large serif number + small explanatory text
stats.data_rule: Only real, defensible metrics should replace placeholders.

closing.purpose: Emotsional yakun va hero orb’ga vizual callback.
closing.statement: The future is not something to stand back and watch. It is something we can shape together.

contact.headline: Bring the idea. We'll give it a presence.

bottom_sheet.hover: gold underline + slight text shift + metadata reveal

animation_system.principle: Controlled, cinematic, deliberate. Motion supports hierarchy; it never competes with content.
smoothness_rules: Use lerp instead of direct pointer mapping.
Use scrub values around 1.0–1.35 for major scroll-linked motion.
Limit pointer displacement to subtle values.
Keep WebGL pixel ratio capped around 1.7.
Do not animate layout properties when transform/opacity can be used.

mobile.navigation: only About + Contact visible in current prototype

reduced_motion_behavior: show text in final readable state
disable custom cursor on small devices
accessibility.contrast: high contrast light text on near-black background
accessibility.interaction_note: All clickable controls should retain keyboard focus styling in production.
accessibility.future_requirement: Add semantic landmarks, ARIA labels where needed, focus-visible states, and proper form/link labels.

performance.priority: Keep cinematic feel without making the page feel heavy.
rules: Use transform and opacity for most motion.
Pause or reduce WebGL work when hero is outside viewport in production.
Prefer 3–5 selected projects rather than a long gallery.

next_best_steps: Replace all placeholder content with real personal information.
Add real editorial portrait in About if desired.
Optimize WebGL to pause outside hero viewport.
Add SEO metadata and Open Graph image.
Add favicon and final personal brand mark.
